import.title: Import bookmarks
import.lead: Export bookmarks from Chrome, Edge or Firefox as HTML and pick the file. Links you already have stay as they are.
import.empty: This file has no bookmarks. Export them from the browser as HTML: in Chrome and Edge, Bookmark manager → ⋯ → Export bookmarks; in Firefox, Bookmarks → Manage bookmarks → Import and Backup → Export Bookmarks to HTML.
import.destinationHint: Library: sorted right away. Inbox: they wait to be sorted, behind the links saved from the browser.
import.rule: Top-level folders become collections, nested folders become tags. Bookmarks bar, Other bookmarks and Mobile are not folders of their own: their links get no collection.
import.progressNote: You can keep working. Nothing is saved until the whole file is in: an error leaves the library as it was.
import.existing: Already in the library — left as they were
import.reason_not_web: Not a web address (javascript:, place:, file:)
import.failed: Couldn't import. {{reason}} Nothing was added — the library is as it was.

restore.checkedBad: Checked: the copy can't be restored
restore.mergeHint: Adds what the library doesn't have. Bookmarks already here stay exactly as they are.
restore.replaceHint: The library becomes the copy. A backup of the current library is saved first.
restore.confirmText_one: The library has {{count, number}} bookmark now; after the restore it will hold the {{copy}} of the copy. A backup of the current library is saved first. Ctrl Z can't undo this.
restore.confirmText_other: The library has {{count, number}} bookmarks now; after the restore it will hold the {{copy}} of the copy. A backup of the current library is saved first. Ctrl Z can't undo this.
restore.added_one: {{count, number}} bookmark added from the copy
restore.added_other: {{count, number}} bookmarks added from the copy
restore.backupFailed: Couldn't save a backup of the current library: {{detail}}. Nothing was changed.
restore.notJson: This isn't a JSON file. Pick a copy made by Koona Pin's Export. Nothing was changed.
restore.notOurs: This isn't a Koona Pin copy: the file has no Koona Pin format. Nothing was changed.
restore.newer: The copy was made by a newer Koona Pin (format {{version}}). Update the app to restore it. Nothing was changed.
restore.damaged: The copy is damaged: {{what}}. Nothing was changed.

connect.title: Connect browser
connect.install_chrome: Open chrome://extensions, turn on Developer mode, choose «Load unpacked» and pick the extension/build/chrome folder.
connect.install_edge: Open edge://extensions, turn on Developer mode, choose «Load unpacked» and pick the extension/build/edge folder.
connect.install_firefox: Open about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox, choose «Load Temporary Add-on…» and pick release/koonapin-firefox.xpi. Until the signed version, Firefox removes it when it closes.
connect.store_chrome: Open the Koona Pin page in the Chrome Web Store and click «Add to Chrome».
connect.store_edge: Open the Koona Pin page in Edge Add-ons and click «Get».
connect.pin_chrome: Open the puzzle-piece menu on the toolbar and pin Koona Pin.
connect.pin_edge: Open the Extensions menu on the toolbar and choose «Show in toolbar» for Koona Pin.
connect.pin_firefox: Open the Extensions menu on the toolbar and choose «Pin to Toolbar» for Koona Pin.
connect.save: Click the icon on any page. If Koona Pin is closed, it starts in the tray and saves the link.
connect.store_firefox: Open the Koona Pin page on Firefox Add-ons and click «Add to Firefox».
connect.save_background: Click the icon on any page. If Koona Pin is closed, it starts in the background and saves the link.
connect.snapFirefox: Firefox from Snap, Ubuntu's default, asks on the first save whether Koona Pin may run. Choose «Allow» — it asks once.
connect.sandboxTitle: Browsers from Flatpak and Chromium from Snap
connect.sandboxText: A browser installed from Flatpak, and Chromium from Snap, can't reach Koona Pin: their sandbox keeps the app out. Use the browser from your distribution's packages or the vendor's site. Firefox from Snap works.
connect.lost_chrome: Make sure the extension is on in chrome://extensions. Links wait in the extension and arrive by themselves.
connect.lost_edge: Make sure the extension is on in edge://extensions. Links wait in the extension and arrive by themselves.
connect.lost_firefox: Make sure the extension is listed in about:addons — a temporary add-on is gone after Firefox restarts. Links wait in the extension and arrive by themselves.
connect.update_chrome: Rebuild the extension and click «Reload» on chrome://extensions. A store version updates by itself.
connect.update_edge: Rebuild the extension and click «Reload» on edge://extensions. A store version updates by itself.
connect.update_firefox: Rebuild the extension and load the new release/koonapin-firefox.xpi. A signed version updates by itself.
connect.updateStore: The extension from the store updates by itself: the browser checks for updates several times a day.

backup.title: Restore from a backup
backup.lead: Pick a copy. The library goes back to how it was then; changes made after it are lost.
backup.empty: No backups in the backups folder yet. Koona Pin makes one when it starts and once a day; a copy saved elsewhere can be chosen as a file.
backup.confirmText_one: The library has {{count}} bookmark now; the copy holds {{copy}}. Everything changed after {{when}} will be lost. A backup of the current library is saved first. Ctrl Z can't undo this.
backup.confirmText_other: The library has {{count}} bookmarks now; the copy holds {{copy}}. Everything changed after {{when}} will be lost. A backup of the current library is saved first. Ctrl Z can't undo this.
backup.confirmClosed: The library that didn't open is moved to the backups folder as it is, and the copy with {{copy}} takes its place.
backup.journalCleared: Undo history was cleared: it pointed to the replaced library.
backup.checkedBad: Checked: the copy can't be restored
backup.notDatabase: This file isn't a database, so it can't be a Koona Pin backup. Nothing was changed.
backup.notOurs: This file belongs to another program, not Koona Pin. Nothing was changed.
backup.newer: A newer Koona Pin made this copy (schema {{schema}}). Update the app to restore it. Nothing was changed.
backup.damaged: The copy is damaged: {{detail}}. Nothing was changed.
backup.unreadable: The copy can't be read: {{detail}}. Nothing was changed.
backup.backupFailed: Couldn't save a backup of the current library: {{detail}}. Nothing was changed.
backup.failed: Couldn't restore the copy: {{detail}}. Nothing was changed.

duplicates.title: Duplicates
duplicates.note: Same page saved more than once: www, http, the final slash, #part and utm_ tags don't count. Merge keeps every note and tag.
duplicates.afterTrash_one: the other one goes to Trash for 30 days
duplicates.afterTrash_other: the other {{count}} go to Trash for 30 days
duplicates.emptyText: Bookmarks saved more than once will show up here. Nothing is merged until you choose.
duplicates.confirmText: {{from}} bookmarks become {{to}}. Notes, tags and stars move to the main ones; the other {{trashed}} go to Trash for 30 days. Ctrl Z undoes it.
duplicates.changed: The group changed meanwhile. It is shown again as it is now.

links.title: Link check
links.introText_one: Koona Pin opens the address of your {{count}} bookmark once, like a browser, without loading the page. The site sees an ordinary request from your computer. You can keep working or stop at any time.
links.introText_other: Koona Pin opens the address of each of your {{count}} bookmarks once, like a browser, without loading the page. Each site sees an ordinary request from your computer. You can keep working or stop at any time.
links.introSmall: Nothing is deleted on its own. Links to this computer or your local network are not requested.
links.stopped: Stopped at {{done}} of {{total}}. What was found so far is kept below.
links.offline: No internet connection. The check paused at {{done}} of {{total}}; links it couldn't reach are not marked.
links.local_one: {{count}} on this computer or local network was not requested
links.local_other: {{count}} on this computer or local network were not requested
links.footer_gone: The site answered 404 or 410: the page is no longer there. Nothing is deleted on its own; Trash keeps bookmarks for 30 days.
links.footer_moved: The page moved for good (301 or 308) and opens at the new address. Replacing keeps notes, tags and collection; Ctrl Z undoes it.
links.footer_failed: Not counted as broken: a site can be down for a while or refuse automatic requests. Check again later or open it yourself.
links.replacedSome_one: {{count}} address replaced · {{skipped}} not: the new address is already saved
links.replacedSome_other: {{count}} addresses replaced · {{skipped}} not: the new address is already saved
links.notReplaced: Not replaced: the new address is already in your library
links.writeFailed: The check stopped: {{reason}}. What it found before is kept.
links.finished_one: Link check finished: {{count}} link needs a look
links.finished_other: Link check finished: {{count}} links need a look

background.title: Koona Pin keeps running
background.text: This desktop has no tray icon, so closing the window only hides it. Links from the browser keep arriving. To open the window again, start Koona Pin from the app menu.
background.hint: To quit, press Ctrl+Q or choose Quit in Settings. To see the icon in the top bar, turn on the AppIndicator extension in Extensions.

gate.reportFailed: Could not copy. Select the report text manually.

DB_LOCKED.title: The library is in use by another program
DB_LOCKED.body: Another program has the library file open. Koona Pin has not written anything to it — your data is as it was. Close that program and click Try again.

DB_NEWER_SCHEMA.title: A newer version of Koona Pin has updated this library
DB_NEWER_SCHEMA.body: The library uses schema {{schema}}; this version supports up to {{supported}}. Install the latest version from koona.app/pin. The library has not been changed.

DB_FOREIGN.title: This is not a Koona Pin library
DB_FOREIGN.body: The file was created by another program. Koona Pin does not open or change it. Move the file out of the data folder and a new library will be created on the next start.

DB_NOT_DATABASE.title: The library file cannot be read
DB_NOT_DATABASE.body: The file is damaged or is not a database. Koona Pin does not change it. Restore the latest backup: the file is kept in the backups folder as it is.

DB_CORRUPT.title: The library is damaged
DB_CORRUPT.body: The integrity check found errors in the library file. To avoid further damage, Koona Pin does not update or change it. Restore the latest backup: the damaged file is kept in the backups folder as it is.

BACKUP_FAILED.title: Could not back up the library before updating it
BACKUP_FAILED.body: {{detail}}. Your data has not been changed.

MIGRATION_FAILED.title: Could not update the library
MIGRATION_FAILED.body: Your data has not been changed.{{backupNote}} The app does not use the library until the error is fixed: send the report to support.

DB_OPEN_FAILED.title: Could not open the library
DB_OPEN_FAILED.body: {{detail}}. Your data has not been changed.

feedback.privacy: Stored in the EU for up to 12 months.
feedback.sentBody: The developer reads every message. If you left an email, the reply will come there.

detail.invalid_email: This doesn't look like an email address. Fix it or leave the field empty.
detail.no_connection: Couldn't send: no internet connection. Your text is kept — try again, or copy it and send it another way.
detail.service_failed: Couldn't send: the server didn't answer. Your text is kept — try again later, or copy it and send it another way.
detail.too_many_messages: Too many messages from this network in the last hour. Your text is kept — try again later.
detail.proxy_failed: Couldn't send through this network's proxy: it asks for a sign-in or isn't reachable. Your text is kept — copy it and send it another way, for example on GitHub.
detail.no_connection_or_proxy: Couldn't send: no internet connection, or this network needs its proxy, which is set by a setup script the app can't use. Your text is kept — try again, or copy it and send it another way, for example on GitHub.
detail.no_connection_or_system_proxy: Couldn't send: no internet connection, or this network needs the proxy from the system settings, which the app can't read — it uses only the https_proxy and http_proxy variables. Your text is kept — try again, or copy it and send it another way, for example on GitHub.
